title: DataspaceProtocolVersion
description: Interface for a single supported Dataspace Protocol version entry.

version.description:
The protocol version identifier (e.g. "2025-1"). An open string to accommodate future
versions; known values are "0.8", "2024-1", and "2025-1".

path.description: The URL path prefix at which the versioned endpoints are served (e.g. "/dsp/2025-1").

binding.description: The transport binding for this version's endpoints.

serviceId.description:
Data Service identifier, allowing a Data Service to group multiple version entries.
Corresponds to the `@id` of the Data Service in the DID document.

auth.description: Authentication descriptor for the versioned endpoints.
